PS Plus co-op games

Every game on PS Plus we've checked for co-op, ranked by Metascore. For our ten favourites of each kind, see the best couch co-op games and the best online co-op games.

What counts as co-op

Co-op means playing on the same side as someone else, whether that's on one console or online. Competitive-only games don't count. Every game here has been checked by hand for couch co-op, online co-op or both, along with how many players each supports.
